free_tier.stated: Quick Transfers are free and have NO file-size limit, but they are ephemeral P2P: 'deleted automatically when either party closes the transfer window'. Persistent storage starts at Starter $6/mo (200 GB storage, 200 GB/file, 14 days).
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: until the instance is recycled; not persistent

egress.terms: free for Quick Transfer (browser-to-browser, so their egress is minimal).

tooling: Open source (github.com/robinkarlberg/transfer.zip-web, 1,514 stars) and self-hostable — which means you can run the whole service on your own box, but that is your storage, not theirs.
chaining: The free path is a WebRTC pipe, so it multiplies to nothing durable. Self-hosting it is a legitimate option only if you already have the disk.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none on Quick Transfer, 200 GB on Starter. Retention: zero on Quick Transfer (session-bound); 14 days on Starter paid. 'Unlimited free file size' on the marketing page refers to the P2P mode.
